notes.title: Electronics Circuits Simulator and Circuit Warz
notes.notes:
The Electronics Circuits Simulator complements the Circuit Warz game which is also available for free on STEAM

It allows you to practice each of the 7 circuit levels without any time constraints or enemies before you play the main game.
